responding_to.type: dialysis patient cut off from clinic

output.english: This is a practice flood alert for Richmond. Rising water is trapping people near Riverside Apartments and Shockoe Bottom, and Upriver Bridge is closed. Stay away from Shockoe Bottom, Downtown Junction, East Junction, and Broad and 3rd, and stay safe until help comes.
output.spanish: Este es un alerta de práctica por inundación para Richmond. El agua está subiendo cerca de Riverside Apartments y Shockoe Bottom, y Upriver Bridge está cerrado. No vaya a Shockoe Bottom, Downtown Junction, East Junction ni Broad y 3rd, y espere ayuda en un lugar seguro.
